messages:
harper: Putting this thread here to lock the final joint bench playbook for marketplace. Partner wants a clear, defensible perf/W number + a fallback config. We need rules for power sampling, thermal headroom notes, and the artifact hosting path.

mina: Proposal: primary power source = external PDU (preferred). If unavailable, accept IPMI but annotate granularity and mark as fallback in the listing. Sample at 200-500ms (recommend 250ms). Warmup = 60s; steady window = next 90s. Also capture chassis inlet temp and PUE note if lab-level HVAC affects readings.

cesar: Add a requirement to report per-socket and per-GPU power if PDU supports per-outlet. We'll include a small CSV schema: timestamp, outlet_watts, device_label. Telemetry should capture tokens/sec, tokens/sec/W (per-GPU and global), p50/p90 latency, kv_hit_rate, batch_histogram, and batch_size distribution.

harper: Good. For marketplace copy we want one "Validated SKU" + a single backup. Acceptance gate: best-config toks/sec/W must be >= 90% of our certified baseline -> "Validated". 75-90% -> "Supported (note: reduced perf)". <75% -> fail to list. Also require smoke eval (100 prompts) and a tiny logprob regression (no >1e-3 mean shift) or manual review.

mina: Let's also record if any kernel tweaks were applied. If partner applies non upstreamable patches, we require a note in listing and a canary flag for early customers. Kernel changes should be categorized as low/medium/high risk and microbench delta included.

cesar: I'll own the kernel-change matrix and microbench harness. Plan: propose up to 4 candidate changes but prioritize non-invasive ones: thread affinity, lightweight matmul reorder, kv prefetch tuning, async-copy fallback. Each candidate gets a microbench (latency & throughput) and a regression smoke.

mina: I'll own telemetry schema and the translator shim. Example CLI we will give partners:
```
# partner run example
./rwd-partner-run --model redwood-7b --seq 256 --batch 32 --quant q4_0 \
  --telemetry /tmp/tel.json --pdu_csv /tmp/pdu.csv --sample-ms 250 --out /tmp/run.json
```
The shim will output canonical fields: power_source, power_resolution_ms, tokens_per_sec, tokens_per_sec_per_watt, run_artifact_uri.

harper: Also include an explicit thermal headroom field: ambient_temp_c and max_chassis_temp_c during steady window. If ambient_temp > 28C, annotate listing and add a short comment about potential throttling.

ops-bot: Partner lab slot requested: booking partner-lab-11 for 2026-04-20 09:00 UTC. Run id rp-5381234 scheduled.

partner-ci: Run rp-5381234 started. Will upload tel.json and pdu.csv to partner S3 on completion.

partner-ci: Run rp-5381234 finished. Quick numbers: seq256 batch32 q4_0 -> 475 toks/s, steady global watts 225W, per-GPU avg 56W => 2.11 toks/s/W. p50 12ms, p90 25ms. ambient_temp_c 24.8, max_chassis_temp_c 67. Raw artifacts: s3://partners/artifacts/5381234/tel.json and s3://partners/artifacts/5381234/pdu.csv

cesar: Pulled artifacts. Microbench note: applying thread-affinity tweak gave +3% toks/sec/W, kv-prefetch was +6% but had a small p90 regression on one microbench (investigating). I'll include all numbers in the patch matrix PR.

mina: Telemetry PR opened with parser and CSV shim: https://git.redwood/partners/telemetry/pulls/61. Includes power_source enum and power_resolution_ms field and an example translator that aligns PDU timestamps with runtime tel.

harper: Ops-bot, run the automated delta check vs our certified baseline and post result. Gate threshold is 10% allowed delta for "Validated".

ops-bot: Perf-check running for rp-5381234.

ops-bot: Perf-check complete. rp-5381234 is 7% below certified baseline toks/sec/W => PASS for "Validated" gate (threshold 10%). Report: https://ci.redwood/perf/rp-5381234/summary.

mina: Great. Cesar/mina please open the patch matrix PR and tag rp-5381234. We want: telemetry PR, patch-matrix PR, and one-pager marketplace blurb with the exact measured toks/sec/W for the validated SKU. Artifacts retention 180 days.

cesar: Will do. Patch-matrix PR incoming with microbench artifacts and risk labels. I'll recommend the thread-affinity + kv-prefetch combo as conservative default if it stays non-regressive.

harper: Final note for listing copy: use exact measured toks/sec/W from the validated SKU and link to the raw tel artifact. If partner used IPMI or lab ambient >28C annotate accordingly. No marketing rounding beyond one decimal place. We'll freeze listing once both PRs are green and perf-check passes. Review meeting Mon 10am PT. :rocket:
